$schema_note: ECS Fargate task definition for the ReciterAI daily-enrichment job (#37 PR 4). Single task definition serves three invocation modes — scheduled daily (no command override), on-demand backfill (`--from-gap-scan` override via `containerOverrides[].command`), and on-demand annual rescore (`--full` override). Templated placeholders below — substitute at deploy time, see infra/README.md and the docs/daily-enrichment.md §7-B runbook. Bedrock authenticates via the `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` bearer token (plan D8 / PR-4 D-Q1); the task role intentionally does NOT carry `bedrock:InvokeModel`.

placeholders.{TASK_ROLE_ARN}: arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT_ID}:role/reciterai-enrichment-task — IAM role attached to the running container; carries the policy in `enrichment_task_iam_policy.json` (DDB write, Secrets Manager read on the 4 secrets below, CloudWatch Logs).
placeholders.{EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN}: arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT_ID}:role/ecsTaskExecutionRole — the standard ECS task execution role; needs `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken`, `ecr:BatchGetImage`, `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` on the 4 secrets, and `logs:CreateLogGroup`/`logs:CreateLogStream`/`logs:PutLogEvents`. The AWS-managed `AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy` covers ECR + Logs; Secrets Manager needs an inline grant matching the 4 ARNs.
placeholders.{IMAGE_URI}: ECR image URI of the pushed reciterai-enrichment image, e.g. `{ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/reciterai-enrichment:{GIT_SHA}`.
placeholders.{DB_SECRET_ARN}: Full ARN of `reciterai/reciter-analysis-db` (JSON SecretString with DB_HOST/DB_USERNAME/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME keys). ECS pulls individual JSON keys via the trailing `:KEY::` syntax.
placeholders.{OPENAI_SECRET_ARN}: Full ARN of `reciterai/openai-api-key` (JSON SecretString with an OPENAI_API_KEY key). Used by the Bedrock content-filter fallback only (D3).
placeholders.{TEAMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET_ARN}: Full ARN of `reciterai/teams-webhook-url` (plain SecretString — the webhook URL itself). The deploy runbook creates this secret if it does not already exist; alerting.py reads `RECITERAI_TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL` from env and tolerates absence (logs-only).
placeholders.{BEDROCK_API_KEY_SECRET_ARN}: Full ARN of `reciterai/bedrock-api-key` (plain SecretString — a LONG-TERM Bedrock API key). Short-term Bedrock keys expire in ≤12h and would break overnight ticks. boto3 auto-detects the value via `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` and uses it as the bearer token for `bedrock-runtime` calls (plan D8).

deploy_notes.sizing: 0.25 vCPU / 1 GB is the smallest viable Fargate size for this workload. The job is I/O-bound (Bedrock + OpenAI API calls + MariaDB writes); CPU is rarely the bottleneck. 1 GB carries headroom for boto3 + SQLAlchemy + the openai client; 0.5 GB would be tight on Python 3.12 + the loaded dependency set.

runtime_modes.scheduled_daily: EventBridge `reciterai-enrichment-daily` rule invokes `RunTask` with no override; the container runs the task definition's default `command` (`python -m scripts.run_daily_enrichment`).
runtime_modes.on_demand_backfill: Operator `aws ecs run-task ... --overrides '{"containerOverrides":[{"name":"reciterai-enrichment","command":["python","-m","scripts.run_daily_enrichment","--from-gap-scan","--verbose"]}]}'`. Same task def, same role, same secrets — only the command changes.
runtime_modes.on_demand_rescore: Operator `aws ecs run-task ... --overrides '{"containerOverrides":[{"name":"reciterai-enrichment","command":["python","-m","scripts.run_daily_enrichment","--full"]}]}'`. The annual rescore — same shape as backfill but a different work-set flag. Cost-guard is bypassed by `--full` (intentionally; rescore is operator-gated).
